verdict.rationale: Datadog's Monitors and Watchdog docs support defining alerting rules that trigger notifications/webhooks/workflows on events (e.g., threshold or anomaly monitors), and Incident Management can be triggered from these events, which supports rule-based automation. However, evidence is thin on AI-native-specific automation (e.g., agentic workflows driven by AI reasoning) beyond standard monitor-to-action pipelines, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of rule-triggered automation depth is present. Missing for 10: evidence of AI-driven/dynamic rule generation, Workflow Automation product specifics, and third-party validation of trigger-action reliability.
